definitions.explanation: The fixed portion of an employee's salary before any additional allowances, bonuses, or overtime pay are added.

examples.japanese: {基本給|きほんきゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧{二十万円|にじゅうまんえん}だ。
examples.english: The base salary is 200,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: {基本給|きほんきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{各種|かくしゅ}→各種：11959_kakushu⟧⟦{手当|てあて}→手当：04881_teate⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく。
examples.english: Various allowances are added to the base salary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{春闘|しゅんとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{基本給|きほんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げ→引き上げ：12552_hikiage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: A raise in base salary was decided during this year's spring labor negotiations.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧ (basic) + {給|きゅう} (salary, pay). In Japanese employment, total compensation typically consists of {基本給|きほんきゅう} plus various ⟦{手当|てあて}→手当：04881_teate⟧ (allowances) such as commuting, housing, and family allowances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {基本給|きほんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げ→引き上げ：12552_hikiage⟧: base salary increase
- {基本給|きほんきゅう}⟦ベース→ベース：08762_beesu⟧: based on base salary
- {基本給|きほんきゅう}+⟦{手当|てあて}→手当：04881_teate⟧: base salary plus allowances

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{手当|てあて}→手当：04881_teate⟧: allowance (additional pay components)
- ⟦{賞与|しょうよ}→賞与：04694_shouyo⟧: bonus (often calculated as multiples of base salary)
- ⟦{年収|ねんしゅう}→年収：05504_nenshuu⟧: annual income (total yearly compensation)
- ⟦{時給|じきゅう}→時給：04693_jikyuu⟧: hourly wage
- ⟦{歩合給|ぶあいきゅう}→歩合給：22050_buaikyuu⟧: commission-based pay
